title: General Material Blend 4-Mix Solo #20 (대각 띠·물결 | 코이비늘+인어비늘+석재+스테인드글라스)
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing or kneeling as described.

Subject: Filipina woman, an adult, in her early 30s, demure and soft expression, warm radiant skin tone — an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. An immense mass of soft heavy fat sits on her middle, sagging down toward her knees under its own weight, gathering into three or four heavy rounded folds stacked one above the other, deep shadowed creases between them, never taut, never smooth, never round like a drum, not pregnant. A gigantic bust resting on the top fold, no waist at all, colossal hips more than three times the width of her shoulders, each thigh thicker than a normal woman's waist, thick heavy calves. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Her face is a real living adult face, warm tan skin, heavy sculpted contour and a glowing highlighter on the cheekbones, smoky bronze and gold glitter eyeshadow, dramatic long lashes, defined dark brows, large eyes with bright real catchlights, glossy coral-red lips, a bright, confident pageant smile, soft rose-gold hair styled in a layered wolf cut with curtain bangs, real pores, real living eyes, 8 drop dangles piercings set with pearls in mixed metal-toned metal, wearing a single piece of gold an anklet. Full body fused with 4 different materials instead of ordinary skin below the collarbones, each material claiming its own region of her figure, covering every inch from neck to ankle without exception, the materials reading as one continuous second skin with no gaps. Her figure is divided into 4 diagonal bands by 3 parallel hazy transition zones running from the upper right to the lower left as seen by the camera, crossing the centre line of her figure about 31% of the way down her figure from the top, about 47% of the way down her figure from the top and about 66% of the way down her figure from the top. Region 1 is everything on the upper side of the first diagonal transition zone: it carries koi scales (rounded smooth scales with fine visible growth rings, each scale glossy and slightly domed), BLAZING METALLIC GOLD scale formations, VIVID PLATINUM scale-edge detail, every scale catching its own glint and casting its own small shadow. Region 2 is the diagonal band between transition zone 1 and transition zone 2: it carries mermaid scales (fine delicate scales, small and closely overlapping with a soft iridescent sheen), BLAZING ELECTRIC TEAL scale formations, VIVID SILVER scale-edge detail, every scale catching its own glint and casting its own small shadow. Region 3 is the diagonal band between transition zone 2 and transition zone 3: it carries solid polished black granite fused directly into her own form, fine natural speckled texture flowing to follow every curve, BLAZING deep charcoal-black granite surface with VIVID silver mineral fleck detail. Region 4 is everything on the lower side of the last diagonal transition zone: it carries solid thick stained glass fused to her form, hundreds of small individual panes each no larger than a coin, BLAZING ELECTRIC VIOLET and VIVID CYAN panes alternating in a dense irregular mosaic, dark lead-line seams webbing between every pane. Where two regions meet, the materials interlock naturally: elements of one reach into the other and the two materials simply touch, so the boundary is made only of the two neighbouring materials, each in its own colours, with no gap between them. Each transition zone follows a gently undulating wave, rising and falling softly, rather than a straight course. The materials of every region continue in full strength over her whole figure, nowhere on her body left bare, no fabric no seam no garment anywhere. Pose: square to camera, feet wide, arms clear of her body, her whole silhouette filling the frame from head to her extreme platform clear heels, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone.

Background: a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in frame. Lighting: a single hard key light raking in from one side, sharp focus head to toe, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph not an illustration not CGI not a render. Pattern density maximum, zero bare skin from neck to ankle. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait, taller than it is wide.
